# Marriage Certificate Apostilles

> Marriage Certificate Apostilles (https://www.marriagecertificateapostilles.com) is a specialized service of American Apostille — American Apostille and Notary Services LLC (https://www.apostillellc.com) — for apostille and authentication of marriage certificates for use abroad. It is a document service, not a law firm.

## What this site covers
- Apostille of U.S. marriage certificates from all 50 states, D.C., and U.S. territories, and authentication of Canadian provincial marriage certificates, for use in other countries.
- Registering a U.S. marriage abroad (consular registration, Italy's AIRE, civil registries), foreign spousal residency permits, retirement-abroad couple documentation, citizenship through marriage, and foreign divorce recognition.
- U.S. agencies (USCIS, the National Visa Center) do not require an apostille on a marriage certificate; apostilles are for presenting the certificate to a foreign authority.

## How it works
- Every request is reviewed before a quote is given. Pricing varies by state or province of issue, destination country, document quantity, and whether the certificate has already been certified at the state level. No prices are published on this site.
- Requests start at https://www.marriagecertificateapostilles.com/contact/
